Card Q&A.a:
This card is treated as a card with the same card number as [P-009 Agumon].This is a special rule, not an effect. Therefore, this text applies when the card is in your hand, breeding area, or any other area. In addition, you can only include up to 4 copies of this card and/or [P-009 Agumon] when building a deck.

If my opponent no longer has any unsuspended Digimon after my opponent's Digimon blocks and suspends, does the battle with my opponent's Digimon proceed with the +1000 DP from this card's inherited effect?

Effect: ※Card Number: Also treated as [P-009]. A deck may not have more than 4 total copies of this and [P-009].
